info.title: Ceramic Glaze Lab — Local Research Prototype

get.description: Deployment probe; does not load the research archive or run chemistry.

schema.title: Response Health Api V1 Health Get

post.description: Run predictions from the case; explicitly pair a declared specimen sensor trace.

schema.title: Response Simulation Thermal Comparison Api V1 Simulations Thermal 1D Compare Post

post.description: Bounded, local, transient conduction; declared properties, no kiln control.

schema.title: Response Simulation Thermal 1D Api V1 Simulations Thermal 1D Post

post.description:
Validate a generic scenario and report supported outputs only.

This endpoint is intentionally a capability gate. It does not run a kiln,
infer material properties, or return surface/defect probabilities.

schema.title: Response Simulation Capabilities Api V1 Simulations Capabilities Post

post.description:
Calculate deterministic dry-batch chemistry for declared scenario layers.

This is intentionally not a firing or surface simulator. Every recipe row
is resolved from the server's exact local analysis snapshot and research-
only catalogue records are rejected instead of being treated as chemistry.

schema.title: Response Simulation Chemistry Api V1 Simulations Chemistry Post
Response Calcite Explorer Api V1 Reactions Calcite Post

post.description:
Run the optional OpenGlaze CLI as an explicitly external reference.

The route is disabled unless ``OPENGLAZE_REPO_ROOT`` points to a locally
downloaded, license-reviewed checkout. Its result never replaces the
deterministic Ceramic Material Intelligence chemistry report.

schema.title: Response Openglaze Umf Reference Api V1 References Openglaze Umf Post

post.description:
Compare our exact local chemistry snapshot with OpenGlaze.

This endpoint is a reproducibility aid, not a consensus engine. It only
compares UMF-equivalent fields and preserves the external report and
material-name limitations separately.

schema.title: Response Compare With Openglaze Api V1 References Openglaze Compare Post

post.description:
Verify a downloaded comparison snapshot without rerunning OpenGlaze.

This endpoint checks the stored comparison arithmetic and input hash. It
intentionally does not fetch or execute the historical external source.

schema.title: Response Replay Openglaze Comparison Api V1 References Openglaze Replay Post

post.description: Persist one immutable comparison snapshot in the local archive.
